comment.body:
All seven usage comparison cases passed. The suite covers source totals, sample flags, request states and access, including the successful retests for phase mixing, denominators and duplicate rows.

[Alpha verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/tree/bafe2d87eaa8a2db34e54dcf584d34e8db2f3786/docs/alpha-release/verification)

All five opponent-defense cases passed. The suite covers league-relative ordering, small and missing samples, changed requests, access and the corrected defensive-score direction.

[Alpha verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/tree/bafe2d87eaa8a2db34e54dcf584d34e8db2f3786/docs/alpha-release/verification)
